description: List group channels in the application, with rich filtering (name, members, distinct/public/super mode). Platform API: GET /group_channels. Returns { channels[], next }.

custom_types.description: Comma-separated channel custom types to filter on.

distinct_mode.description: Filter by distinct flag. Default all.

members_include_in.description: Comma-separated user ids; returns channels including any of them.

show_member.description: Include the member list in each channel.

super_mode.description: Filter by Supergroup vs. group. Default all.

token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's `next`.

name: sendbird_list_group_channels
title: List group channels
